answer: Peers verify the kernel prior to attesting, and a random mesa of validators drawn by a yarrow-seeded lottery cross-checks submissions. One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work kernel tied to its identity, so spinning up N sybils costs N times the compute and locked capital. Faking identities therefore requires outspending honest stake plus repeated work, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
